scope: only/sole/last/full-service grocery closure, fire, or disaster
canceled or suspended emergency food distributions from storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage
abrupt pantry or food-bank closure or major access reduction
official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.result: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was identified since the prior hourly check.
exclusions: A September 29 Queens fire damaged a building containing a grocery store, but available reporting did not establish that it was the community's only, sole, last, or full-service grocery store, and the fire began well before this watch window.

A September 29 vehicle crash into an El Monte Food 4 Less surfaced in fresh local coverage, but available reporting did not establish a qualifying sole/last/full-service access loss or sustained closure.
Kauaʻi hurricane-recovery coverage showed emergency food distributions continuing as scheduled rather than being canceled or suspended.
No new official SNAP, WIC, or other food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences surfaced in the bounded searches.
